Garlic Tincture

The necromancer on Death Island says only a special potion can break the spell that raises the dead throughout the region. It should be buried on the island in an ancient hero's grave.

Objectives

Reach the eastern part of the island

Go to the tomb

Collect the potion

Destroy the hero
